`2021 – 2024`

**Topics:** renewable energy · environmental & social impact assessment · lender standards

**My contributions:** baseline studies, impact assessment chapters, noise and shadow flicker modelling

**Skills used:** WindPro, R, GIS, IFC Performance Standards, ADB Safeguard Policies

## Overview

Wind power is central to Vietnam's energy transition, and international lenders require projects to meet IFC Performance Standards and ADB Safeguard Policies. At ERM Vietnam, I contributed to Environmental and Social Impact Assessments (ESIA) and Management Plans (ESMP) for wind farms seeking international financing.

## Projects

- **Alpha and Beta Onshore Wind Power Projects**, Vietnam (EDF Renouvelables Group, France)
- **Phu Cuong Soc Trang Offshore Wind Farm, Phase 1A and 1B**, Soc Trang Province, Vietnam (Mainstream Phu Cuong Co., Ltd)

## My role

- Supervised environmental fieldwork across water, soil, air, noise and biodiversity
- Authored the **Environmental Baseline** chapter: climate, hydrology and topography
- Authored impact chapters on surface water, groundwater, air, noise and soil
- Modelled **ambient noise, shadow flicker and visual amenity** using WindPro, R and GIS
